statement: The function returns a result r, and r equals the number of pairs (i,j) with 0 <= i <= j < len(s) such that the contiguous substring s[i], s[i+1], ..., s[j] contains at least one occurrence of byte 97 ('a'), at least one occurrence of byte 98 ('b'), and at least one occurrence of byte 99 ('c').
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail, panic, or overflow) on every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= 0.
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= len(s) * (len(s) + 1) / 2.
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= (len(s) - 1) * (len(s) - 2) / 2.
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 1 if s contains all three of the bytes 97, 98, and 99 (equivalently, the three bytes of s are a permutation of 'a','b','c'), and r = 0 otherwise.
preconditions: len(s) = 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if at least one of the bytes 97, 98, or 99 does not occur anywhere in s, then r = 0.
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if each of the bytes 97, 98, and 99 occurs at least once in s, then r >= 1.
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r > 0 if and only if there exist indices i and j with 0 <= i <= j < len(s) such that s[i], s[i+1], ..., s[j] contains at least one occurrence of each of the bytes 97, 98, and 99.
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every k with 0 <= k <= len(s), the number of pairs (i,j) with 0 <= i <= j < k such that s[i], s[i+1], ..., s[j] contains at least one occurrence of each of 97, 98, and 99 is at most r.
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every k with 0 <= k <= len(s), the number of pairs (i,j) with k <= i <= j < len(s) such that s[i], s[i+1], ..., s[j] contains at least one occurrence of each of 97, 98, and 99 is at most r.
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r plus the number of pairs (i,j) with 0 <= i <= j < len(s) whose substring s[i], s[i+1], ..., s[j] misses at least one of the bytes 97, 98, or 99 equals len(s)*(len(s)+1)/2.
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r for s, if t is the byte slice of length len(s) defined by t[i] = s[len(s)-1-i] for every 0 <= i < len(s), then the number of pairs (u,v) with 0 <= u <= v < len(t) such that t[u], t[u+1], ..., t[v] contains at least one occurrence of each of 97, 98, and 99 is also r.
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r for s, for every bijection p from the set {97, 98, 99} to itself, if t is the byte slice defined by t[i] = p(s[i]) for every 0 <= i < len(s), then the number of pairs (u,v) with 0 <= u <= v < len(t) such that t[u], t[u+1], ..., t[v] contains at least one occurrence of each of 97, 98, and 99 is also r.
preconditions: len(s) >= 3, len(s) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of the byte values 97 ('a'), 98 ('b'), 99 ('c').
